S5_StringLiteral_decision_comment: S5 decision: the StringLiteral mutator is excluded for packages/contract.
This package is almost entirely declarative zod schema definitions: wire DTOs
and input shapes. Measured StringLiteral survivors (164 of 390) are dominated
and object-key spellings - internal wire identifiers, not product copy. A test
pinning each exact enum string asserts a tautology TypeScript already enforces.
The genuine product copy (#792 plain-words validation) lives in friendly-errors.ts
and the schemas' own error: messages; those are asserted BEHAVIOURALLY (the
rendered sentence a user sees) by friendly-errors.test.ts and http-url.test.ts,
which is the right oracle - not that a literal equals itself. Every NON-string
mutator stays enabled and is killed by a real test, including all logic in
http-url.ts (the SSRF guard), where no survivor is tolerated or marked equivalent.
